वैराणक g. उत्करादि.

m: वैरागी f. (in music) a partic. Rāgiṇī, Saṃgīt.

s: klI, (virAgasya BAvaH । virAga + zyaY .) vizayatucCaDIH । yaTA, -- “jYAnavErAgyayorBaktipraveSAyopayogitA । Izat praTamameveti nANgatvamucitaM tayoH ॥ yaduBe cittakAWinyahetU prAyaH satAM mate । sukumArasvaBAveyaM BaktistadDeturIritA ॥” yaTA ekAdaSaskanDe । “tasmAnmadBaktiyuktasya yogino vE madAtmanaH । na jYAnaM na ca vErAgyaM prAyaH Sreyo Bavediha ॥” iti ॥ kintu jYAnaviraktyAdisADyaM BaktyEva sidDyati । yaTA tatrEva । “yat karmmaBiryattapasA jYAnavErAmyataSca yat । yogena dAnaDarmmeRa SreyoBiritarErapi ॥ sarvvaM madBaktiyogena madBakto laBate'YjasA । svargApavargaM madDAma kaTaYcidyadi vAYCati ॥ rucimudvahatastatra janasya Bajane hareH । vizayezu garizWo'pi rAgaH prAyo vilIyate ॥ anAsaktasya vizayAn yaTArhamupayuYjataH । nirvvanDaH kfzRasambanDe yuktaM vErAgyamucyate ॥ prApaYcikatayA budDyA harisambanDivastunaH ॥ mumukzuBiH parityAgo vErAgyaM Palgu kaTyate ॥” iti BaktirasAmftasinDO pUrvvaBAge sADanalaharI ॥
v: na॰ virAgasya BAvaH zyaYa । vizayavAsanArAhitye EhikAmuzmikavizayarAgarAhitye ca । vErAgyasya mokzahetutvAdi vivekacUqAmaRO darSitaM yaTA “mokzasya hetuH praTamo nigadyate vErAgyamatyantamanityavastuzuM tataH SamaScApi damastitikzA nyAsaH prasaktAKilakarmaRAM BfSam । tataH SrutistanmananaM satattvaDyAnaM ciraM nityanirantaraM muneH । tato vikalpaM parametya vidvAnihEva nirvARamuKaM samfcCati । yadbAdDavyaM tavedARimAtmAnAtmavivecanam । taducyate mayA samyak SrutvAtmanyavaDAraya । majjAsTimedaHpalaraktacarmatvagAhvayErDAtuBireBiranvitam । pAdoruvakzoBujapfzWamastakEraNgErupANgErupayuktametat । ahaM mameti praTitaM SarIraM mohAspadaM sTUlamitIryyate buDeH । naBonaBasvaddahanAmbumUmayaH sUkzmARi BUtAti Bavanti tAni । parasparAMSErmilitAni BUtvA sTUlAni ca sTUlaSarIrahetavaH । mAtrAstadIyA vizayA Bavanti SabdAdayaH paYca suKAya BoktuH । ya ezu mUQA vizayezu badDvA rAgorupASena sudurdamena । AyAnti niryyAntyaDa UrdDvamuccEH svakarmadUtena javena nItAH । SabdAdiBiH paYcaBireva paYca paYcatvamApuH sva guRena badDAH । kuraNgamAtaNgapataNgamInaBfNgA, naraH paYcaBiraYcitaH kim? । dozeRa tIvrA vizayaH kfzRasarpavizAdapi । vizaM nihanti BoktAraM drazwAraM cakzuzApyayam । vizayASA mahApASAt yo vimuktaH sudustyajAt । sa eva kalpate muktyE nAnyaH zawSAstravedyapi । ApAtavErAgyavato mumukzUn BavAbDipAraM pratiyAtumudyatAn । ASAgraho majjayate'ntarAle nigfhya kaRWe vinivartya vegAt । vizayAKyagraho yena suviraktyasinA hataH । sa gacCati BavAmBADeH pAraM pratyUhavarjitaH । vizamavizayamArgErgacCato nazwabudDeH pratipadamaBiyAto mftyu rapyeza sidDiH । hitasujanagurUktyA gacCataH svasya yuktyA praBavati PalasidDiH satyamityeva vidDi । mokzasya kANkzA yadi vE tavAsti tyajAtidUrAdvizayAn vizaM yaTA । pIyUzavattozadayAkzamArjavapraSAntidAntIrBaja nityamAdarAt” ।
m: वैराग्य n. change or loss of colour, growing pale, Suśr.; Kām.
disgust, aversion, distaste for or loathing of (loc. abl., or comp.), Bhag.; Ragh. &c.
freedom from all worldly desires, indifference to worldly objects and to life, asceticism, Up.; MBh. &c.
a: वैराग्यं — [विरागस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Absence of worldly desires or passions, indifference to the world, asceticism; अभ्यासेन च कौंतेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते Bg. 6. 35, 13. 8. --2 Dissatistaction, displeasure, discontent; कामं प्रकृतिवैराग्यं सद्यः शमयितुं क्षमः R. 17. 55. --3 Aversion, dislike. --4 Grief, sorrow.

m: वैराग्य—शतक n. ‘100 verses on freedom from worldly desires’, N. of the third century of Bhartṛhari's moral sentiments and of sev. other works.
वैराग्य—चन्द्रिका f. N. of wk.

relating to or containing the Sāman Vairāja, VS.; TS.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
belonging to Brahmā, Uttarar.

of Manu or of the Manus, VP.
of the Vedic Ṛṣi Ṛṣabha, MW.

of the father of Ajita, BhP.

of a class of Pitṛs, MBh.; Hariv.; VP.
of partic. worlds, Uttarar.

of various Sāmans, AV.; VS.; Br. &c.

deformity, ugliness, MBh.; Hariv.; Yājñ. &c.
a: वैरूप्यं — [विरूपस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Deformity, ugliness; R. 12. 40. --2 Difference or diversity of form.

m: वैरूप्य—ता f. state of deformity, MBh.

s: klI, (vIrasya karmma BAvo vA । vIra + aR .) viroDaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 8 । 7 । 39 । “badDavErezu BUtezu mohitezvAtmamAyayA ॥”) tasya samutTAnaM paYca । strIkftam 1 yaTA kfzRaSiSupAlayoH । vAstujam 2 yaTA kOravapARqavAnAm । vAgjam 3 yaTA droRadrupadayoH । sApatnam 4 yaTA mUzikamArjArayoH । aparADajam 5 yaTA pUjanIbrahmadattayoH । iti mahABAratam ॥

m: वैर mfn. (fr. वीर) hostile, inimical, revengeful, AV.
वैर n. (exceptionally m. [?] ifc. f(आ). ) enmity, hostility, animosity, grudge, quarrel or feud with (instr. with or without सह, or सार्धम्, or comp.; often pl.), AV.; PañcavBr.; MBh. &c.
वैर n. heroism, prowess, W.
a hostile host, Śiś.
money paid as a fine for manslaughter, TāṇḍyaBr.
a: वैरं — [वीरस्य भावः अण्] 1 Hostility, enmity, animosity, spite, grudge, opposition, quarrel; दानेन वैराण्यपि यांति नाशं Subhāṣ.; अज्ञातहृदयेष्वेवं वैरीभवति सौहृदं Ś. 5. 24 ‘turns into enmity’; विधाय वैरं सामर्षे नरोऽरौ य उदासते . प्राक्षिण्योदर्चिषं कक्षे शेरते तेऽभिमारुतं Śi. 2. 42. --2 Hatred, revenge. --3 Heroism, prowess. --Comp. --अनुबंधः commencement of hostilities. --अनुबंधिन् a. leading to enmity. (--m.) {1} the heating solar ray. {2} N. of Viṣṇu. --आतंकः the Arjuna tree. --आनृण्यं, --उद्धारः, निर्यातनं, --प्रतिक्रिया, --प्रतीकारः, --यातना, --शुद्धिः f., --साधनं requital of enmity, taking revenge, retaliation. --करः, --कारः, --कृत् m. an enemy. --भावः hostile attitude. --रक्षिन् a. guarding against hostilities.

k.v: वैरं विरोधो विद्वेषो मन्युशोकौ तु शुक्स्त्रियाम्. पश्चात्तापोऽनुतापश्च विप्रतीसार इत्यपि॥

m: वैर—भाव m. hostility, BhP.
वैर—खण्डिन् mfn. breaking or destroying hostility, Cat.
